segments.script: [EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Xin chào.] [EN: This means hello.] [VI_F: Xin] [EN: has a flat tone.] [VI_F: Chào] [EN: has a falling tone.] [EN: Say hello.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To say thank you.] [VI_F: Cảm ơn.] [EN: This means thank you.] [VI_F: Cảm] [EN: has a falling, rising tone.] [VI_F: Ơn] [EN: has a flat tone. Keep your lips relaxed for this vowel, not rounded.] [EN: Say thank you.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: There is no word for please in Vietnamese. Politeness comes from one small word.] [VI_F: Dạ.] [EN: This is a polite yes, and a soft, respectful way to begin a reply. It has a falling, broken tone.] [EN: Say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: Now soften your thank you. Say, yes, thank you.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let us practice. How do you say hello?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: Say thank you.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn.] [EN: Say the polite yes.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: Soften it. Say, yes, thank you.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Cảm ơn.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Thank you.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Dạ.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: A polite yes.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Xin chào.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Hello.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Greet someone.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: Politely thank them.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn.]

[EN: Quick review.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hello.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: A polite yes.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: Thank you.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Dạ.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: A polite yes.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen to a short, polite exchange.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Xin chào!] [VI_M: Dạ, xin chào.] [VI_F: Cảm ơn nha.] [EN: She added] [VI: nha] [EN: a friendly softener.] [VI_M: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Greet her.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: Thank her politely.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you learn how to address people. The preview word is] [VI: anh] [EN: which is how you address an older man.]
